red_team.seed_dependence: Final results are near-pseudoreplicates, with bit-identical final deltas in several seeds/arms; effective seed count is approximately 1 per arm. Do not report a three-seed noise interval. Use family bootstrap and leave-one-context-out evidence over the 19 validation families.
red_team.selection_bias: H46-C step48 was chosen as best among five arms and eight checkpoints using DL-Val (40 looks); its per-checkpoint CI is unadjusted and exploratory. Final C is negative.
red_team.arm_win_rule: Median FINAL delta > 0 and family-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0; checkpoint selection must use inner family-grouped CV on training families. H46 did not meet the selection-protocol requirement because it evaluated checkpoints on DL-Val.
red_team.h47_comparison: H47 remains queued for comparability. Its full-batch default also makes seeds near-pseudoreplicates; report that limitation and compare against H46-0 last attempted candidate delta -0.004087 (accepted restore-on-reject incumbent remains r785 at delta 0) and H46-A under the same EMA protocol. H47 has no in-wave control because arm == '0' is dead code.

analysis_protocol.seed_dependence_note: Each seed uses the full 1,219-context training batch; seeds only alter the sampled slate portion. Observed final outputs are near-pseudoreplicates (effective seed count approximately 1 per arm), so no interval is presented as seed-noise uncertainty. Arm-level intervals resample the 19 DL-Val families and summarize the median seed metric.
analysis_protocol.selection_protocol: H46 evaluated every checkpoint on DL-Val and therefore did not use inner family-grouped train CV; checkpoint trajectory findings are exploratory, and no H46 arm can qualify as a selected win.
analysis_protocol.winner_curse_note: H46-C step48 was the best-of-5-arms-by-8-checkpoints DL-Val selection (40 looks); its positive point and per-checkpoint CI are exploratory without multiplicity correction. Final C is negative.
analysis_protocol.arm_win_rule: Median final delta > 0 and family-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0, with selection using inner family-grouped cross-validation over train families. H46 fails the selection-protocol requirement; no arm is a selected win.

early_findings.objective_mismatch: A/B training loss falls while train utility and DL-Val utility both fall; consistent with objective mismatch, not ordinary overfitting.
early_findings.seed_dependence: Full 1,219-context batch each step; seeds only alter random portions of training slates. Near-pseudoreplicates; family-bootstrap intervals are conditional context/family uncertainty, not independent-seed noise.
early_findings.hopeless_rule: A seed0 operational rule chosen after observation: upper family-bootstrap CI < 0 and all leave-one-context-out deltas < 0.
early_findings.next_arm: H46-D family-balanced per-context Huber/KL loss; queued after 0/A/B/C.
